reels.title: LOCI: Spatial Linear Memory for Streaming World Models

editorial_notes.reasoning: This paper offers a perfect balance of high 'hardware_efficiency' viral potential and strong 3b1b visual geometry potential. Streaming world models are intrinsically visual, allowing for elegant animations of memory 're-mapping' as the camera pans through space.
editorial_notes.recommended_hook: Why does your AI get 'dizzy' when it turns back to look at where it just came from?
editorial_notes.suggested_everyday_analogy: A physical map that automatically unfolds and highlights the room you are currently standing in as you walk through a house.
